ns.description: Checkpoint, branch, submit, and land Graphite-backed work.

commands.name: changes
commands.description: Summarize outstanding worktree changes without committing.

commands.name: cp
commands.description: Create a checkpoint commit for the current diff.

commands.name: autobranch
commands.description: Create a Graphite branch from dirty worktree changes.

commands.name: branch-latest-commit
commands.description: Move the latest eligible commit to a new Graphite branch.

commands.name: autoslot
commands.description: Create a Graphite branch from current work, then move it into a managed slot worktree.

commands.name: submit
commands.description: Checkpoint pending changes, then submit the Graphite stack with gt submit.

commands.name: regenerate-pr
commands.description: Regenerate the PR title and ns-managed body region.

commands.name: push
commands.description: Push committed non-Graphite branch work with git push.

commands.name: land
commands.description: Land the current PR or Graphite stack into trunk.

commands.name: pull-trunk
commands.description: Pull the configured Graphite trunk branch without running full gt sync.

commands.name: exec-read-graphite-branch-metadata
commands.description: Read Graphite branch metadata for flow internals.
